notes.alumni-memorial-union: The Alumni Memorial Union holds Marquette Place, the food court that is Marquette's dining spot outside the residence halls (marquette.edu/alumni-memorial-union/dining.php); the three dining halls are inside Cobeen Hall, Straz Tower and The Commons, which are housing.
notes.marquette-gymnasium: The old Marquette Gymnasium now houses Navy and Army ROTC ('Gymnasium (Navy ROTC/Army ROTC)', marquette.edu/tools/building-names.php), not a student gym; Wellness + Helfaer is the rec centre.
notes.al-mcguire-center: Varsity basketball and volleyball arena (gomarquette.com/facilities). Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.the-313-building: 313 Building holds HR, Finance and IT offices (marquette.edu/tools/building-names.php). Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.zilber-hall: Administration building (president's office, admissions, financial aid). Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.versiti-blood-center-of-wisconsin: A blood centre, not a Marquette building.
notes.humphrey-hall: Glenn Humphrey Hall is a Marquette residence hall (marquette.edu/residence-life/residence-halls/), not a class building.
notes.haggerty-museum-of-art: Art museum. Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.gilman-building: University apartments (Gilman Building, 1621 W. Wells St., under residence halls on marquette.edu/tools/building-names.php).
notes.frenn-building: University apartments (Frenn Building, 1615 W. Wells St., under residence halls on marquette.edu/tools/building-names.php).
notes.525-building: Commercial building on N. 6th St. downtown, not on Marquette's building names list.
notes.klein-family-kbs-soccer-pavilion: Varsity soccer pavilion at Valley Fields.
notes.valley-fields-stair-tower: Stair tower at the Valley Fields athletic complex.
